content:
lina: Quick heads-up — I want to run a short night-drop for py/ts SDKs to push an ephemeral dist-tag and publish the deprecation note for the legacy sync client. Targeting in 30m. Anyone object?
kevin: no objections. what's the dist-tag name so CI can point at it?
alex: +1 from me. suggest `ephemeral-integration-2026-03-21` so it doesn't collide with other tags.
maria: FYI we need to add the deprecation blurb to both CHANGELOG and the npm/pypi metadata before publish. I'll prepare the snippet.
lina: plan: 1) publish wheels/wheelhouse to test PyPI with `--no-clean` 2) npm publish with `--tag ephemeral-integration-2026-03-21` 3) set npm dist-tag and pip index alias 4) run integration suite against canary gateway. If any signature mismatch or 403 we rollback.
samir: what's our rollback criteria? e.g., >1% 500s or failed auth to pypi (we had signer drift last month)
kevin: keep it tight: if any pypi 403 or deploy-bot reports `signer-mismatch` -> immediate yank and set dist-tag back. For runtime, if >0.5% 5xx or >300ms median token latency in SDK smoke tests we'll revert.
maria: I pasted the deprecation blurb: "The legacy sync client (package `@redwood/sdk-sync`) is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. Please migrate to the async client or the new unified client. See https://redwood.ai/migrate-sync for guidance."
lina: thanks. I'll add that to CHANGELOG and the npm `package.json` "deprecated" field before publish.
deploy-bot: [483210-483211] publish-job started: py -> testpypi (job id: jb_48321), npm -> registry (job id: nb_48321) :rocket:
kevin: if deploy-bot complains about signer drift, do we have a key rotation fallback?
samir: yes — fallback is to use the archived key `key-2025-11` from the keyring and republish; I've tested that locally. It requires manual approval from @maria though.
lina: will hold approval if any signer issues show up. Also I'll pin the release candidate in the monorepo `package.json` with "@redwood/sdk": "1.4.3-rc.1" and add a note to `deploy/README.md` to avoid auto-upgrading.
alex: add a yarn resolution in the webapp tests to pin `@redwood/sdk` so prow won't silently pull `latest`. Something like: ```json
"resolutions": {"@redwood/sdk": "1.4.3-rc.1"}
```
maria: publish preflight checklist: 1) checksum sign matches 2) CHANGELOG updated 3) `deprecated` field set for sync package 4) dist-tag created 5) smoke tests green
lina: running now. will post back at each step.
deploy-bot: [483211-483212] py publish complete -> testpypi (jb_48321) SUCCESS. sha256: abc123...
lina: pushing npm now with tag `ephemeral-integration-2026-03-21`
deploy-bot: [483212-483213] npm publish (nb_48321) FAILED: signer-mismatch on package upload. See logs: `error: signature verification failed for /tmp/pkg.tgz`
kevin: bummer. samir can you swap to fallback key?
samir: doing it now. will re-sign and re-run.
maria: re-issuing approval for fallback key. please hold on the dist-tag until deploy-bot confirms success.
samir: re-signed and re-published locally, logs look good. re-triggering publish job.
deploy-bot: [483213-483214] npm publish (nb_48321) RE-STARTED with key key-2025-11 (manual override by samir)
deploy-bot: [483213-483215] npm publish (nb_48321) SUCCESS. dist-tag set -> ephemeral-integration-2026-03-21
lina: integration tests are running against canary gateway now. watching metrics.
deploy-bot: [483214-483216] integration-suite started (is_48321)
alex: while we're here, we should also create a short release-notes snippet for marketing: one paragraph + migration link. I can draft it if y'all OK.
maria: please do. include the deprecation callout and migration doc link.
kevin: metrics: first 5 minutes look clean. 0.12% transient 5xxs, median latency +10ms vs baseline — acceptable.
lina: good. i'll keep the dist-tag for 24h then clear it and create a permanent canary tag if everything stays green.
samir: once you clear it, also add a follow-up task to remove the deprecated package page in 90 days, per policy.
alex: draft release note: "SDK: introduced RC with async-first unified client; legacy sync client deprecated (see migration guide). This RC is being distributed to integration partners via ephemeral dist-tag for testing."
maria: looks good. please add link to docs and the scheduled removal window (90d).
deploy-bot: [483215-4832113400] integration-suite complete: PASS (is_48321). no signer issues post-override.
lina: closing this thread. summary: published RC -> ephemeral-integration-2026-03-21, signer fallback used, smoke/integration tests passed. We'll keep tag for 24h then reconcile and promote to `canary` if no regressions. tagging follow-ups in the release board. :white_check_mark:
